text: Demonstrate autonomous external value creation with a real beneficiary
description: Prove that the mission-continuous loop can produce value outside Aimparency. A human may define or approve the initial aim and supply necessary access; after that, the loop must discover the work, plan, execute with real tools, verify the deliverable, and present it without step-by-step steering. Success requires (1) a named external beneficiary or external open-source project, (2) a non-trivial deliverable addressing a real need, (3) a preserved run record showing the autonomous chain, and (4) external acceptance, use, merge, payment, or explicit useful/not-useful feedback. An internal Aimparency artifact, self-assessed usefulness, mock customer, simulated revenue, or unsubmitted patch does not satisfy this aim. Start with a credential-free external repository contribution or a deliverable requested by Wilde Möhre/Herzog Records; expand to paid/effectful work only with human authorization.
reflection: The reopened agent-actionable bounty scan is complete with a negative selection result. Remaining success criteria require external institutional participation, authorization, and beneficiary acceptance; internal work cannot satisfy them.

supportingConnections.explanation: Creates externally accepted, paid value for a named open-source beneficiary through an inspectable autonomous run.

status.comment: No qualifying public bounty was found in the verified 20-entry scan. External proof now requires either a future qualifying issue plus the standing mandate, or a consenting real beneficiary such as the scheduled Robin collaboration.
